$comment: The contract of .agents/harness.config.json, the one file that holds this project's harness settings. pnpm verify:harness-config holds the file to it, reading only the keywords it knows (type, properties, required, additionalProperties, enum, const, if, then, else, and the annotations $schema, $comment, title, description and default) and refusing any other, so a rule written here is never skipped in silence. additionalProperties is true or false, never a schema, and every object outside an if, then or else sets it to false, so every key the file holds is one declared here; neither file gives a key twice in one object. A default is the value the template ships and the one a skill assumes when the file records none; each must be one of its own enum. See docs/harness.md section 3g.
title: Harness config
description: The project's harness settings: its workflow, its merge policy and its backend.

$schema.description: The path of this contract, relative to .agents/, so an editor checks the file as it is typed.

$comment.description: A note for the reader of the file.

workflow.description: How a change is specified and recorded (decision 40).

$comment.description: A note for the reader of the section.

mode.description: sdd: OpenSpec in the repository, chosen by size (openspec/README.md). odd: the feature-document workflow, its document committed.

delivery.description: Who may merge a pull request into the default branch (decision 38).

$comment.description: A note for the reader of the section.

mergePolicy.description: manual: the architect asks the owner before every merge. low-risk: the architect may merge, without asking, a pull request that meets every condition of ticket-flow rule 4.

backend.description: The backend the project runs, and how its database tests run.

$comment.description: A note for the reader of the section.

kind.description: supabase: packages/supabase, the harness's own. own: a backend of the project's, which the harness does not manage. none: no backend.

databaseTests.description: linked: the pgTAP tests run against the linked Supabase project. local: against a local Supabase stack. off: no database tests run.

then.description: a supabase backend names how its database tests run

else.description: the database-test mode is the supabase backend's only; the harness does not manage the tests of an own backend
